cohorts: Keep all 28 R170 and 32 R171 new-frame directional records with both endpoint identities verified, equivalent to 30 physical frames. These are exposed mechanism-analysis cohorts with shared physical observations between source directions. Keep unavailable and unknown outcomes. The broader 168-record sealed R171 population provides label-free C/D links and an optional paired readout replay.
attribution: Use the archived D-native joint winner and the same exact objective. Find the maximum-scoring pair whose two owners match the separately verified identities, using the unchanged R171 point-ownership rule. For reachable correct pairs report winner minus best-verified-pair subject unary, D-reference unary, signed left/right factor and total, the D rank of the highest-ranked correct reference and of the chosen indices, and the winner identities including UNKNOWN. Compare fixed-pool diagnostics with one term removed, keeping tie order. Report missing subject or reference separately. No new optimizer.
geometry: R171 preserved both the unrotated donor centers/sizes and their PCA output yaw. Verify recovery of D's pre-PCA support statistics and the archived factor rows from the stored points, visibility and image projection. Recover original subject mask by testing axis-aligned and saved orientations and retain all distinct masks consistent with both stored support statistics and factor rows. On each chosen pair and its best verified competitor, delete one visible seed from their union and recompute the same intervals and factor. Report support counts, interval width range, positive, negative and zero factor behavior, and whether the same single deletion can close or reverse the pair-score gap with unaries fixed. This is a local robustness diagnostic, not a new score or a full sampling uncertainty model.
oracle: For every verified row with at least one correct D reference proposal, restrict the reference to those proposals and use the original R171 objective for the subject selection, without changing scores, candidates, relation or yaw. Report native joint and R158 values on the exact same subset, plus all-60 descriptive fallback where no correct reference is available. This is identity-labeled offline diagnostic data only. No target identity or score enters C/D construction or an inference rule.
verification: The C archive has native boxes in their original descending semantic order but lacks native score magnitudes. Use C reciprocal rank as the no-refit identity signal. Build mutual unique-best overlap between C and D in the same archived 16,384-point sample, using the inherited >=3 common unique points and Jaccard >=0.25 rule in both directions. No query IDs. A linked D box gets 1/C-rank, unlinked receives zero additive evidence. Compare D unary alone, D plus this fixed unit-bounded signal, and D plus the same evidence multiset cyclically shifted to wrong D positions by a fixed case hash. Seal associations and scores before reading labels. Audit overlap assignments against known physical owners when both can be identified.
identity_comparison: On the original D pool report correct top-one, reciprocal rank and paired gains/losses over all 28 and 32 rows, including no rewrite. Also compute within-record correct-versus-known-wrong instance concordance, coalescing duplicate boxes of a known owner by max score, and assigning ties 0.5. Give each evaluable record equal weight, report separate cohorts, and exclude unknown owners from this specific discrimination measure only. Unknowns stay in proposal ranks and top-one denominators.
optional_readout_gate: Proceed with the predeclared matched readout only if aligned C+D improves the within-record concordance over both D-only and shifted evidence in each cohort and does not reduce correct top-one counts relative to either counterpart in either cohort. This screens consistent positive identity evidence, not statistical significance. If passed, reuse the same D pool, archived left/right factor and R171 assign for aligned evidence independent/joint and shifted joint versus archived D joint on 168 records, with no fitted thresholds or source/target training. Otherwise finish and retain the signal as a negative verification result.
unknown: Audit the minimum per-subject advantage over archived UNKNOWN of the available physical reference after adding the signed factor. A physical best unary is zero, the null is -2 and the factor is bounded by 1. Record the actual advantages and cases. The audit does not introduce an alternative accept/reject score.
decision: Separate ranking evidence, oracle opportunity, and deployable gains. Keep every negative, fallback, and unknown. No new candidates, box fitting, solver, model pass, parameter update, FINAL reading, or deployment switch.
